Tree: The node arena: stores nodes, computes layout, routes input and tracks focus.
Tree::absolute_position: Returns a node's on-screen position, including every ancestor's transform.
Tree::activate: Activates a node directly, as if it had been clicked, and returns the outcome.
Tree::add_child: Attaches a child under a parent in both the node and layout structures.
Tree::ancestors: Iterates a node and then each of its ancestors up to the root, innermost first.
Tree::apply_active_tab: Attaches only the zone's active tab panel to the container and detaches the others.
Tree::build_access_update: Builds a fresh accessibility tree update from the current nodes.
Tree::can_scroll: Returns whether a scroll view or list can move by the given amount along its axis.
Tree::cancel_press: Ends the current press without a click and releases any pointer capture.
Tree::children_in_paint_order: Returns a node's children bottom first, ordered by z-index then child order.
Tree::clear_focus: Leaves nothing focused and returns the old and new focus if it changed.
Tree::close_overlay: Closes an overlay by detaching its subtree while keeping the content alive.
Tree::collect_unreferenced: Frees a detached subtree if the caller no longer references any node in it.
Tree::compute_layout: Computes layout for a root's whole subtree within the available space.
Tree::content_children: Returns a node's children other than its open overlays, in order.
Tree::cut_text_field_selection: Removes and returns the selected text of a text field.
Tree::destroy: Frees a node and its whole subtree, returning every freed id.
Tree::detach: Detaches a child from its parent without deleting it.
Tree::detach_collectible: Detaches a node from its parent and keeps it alive until it is collected.
Tree::dispatch: Handles one input event for a root and returns what the host must act on.
Tree::extend_terminal_selection: Moves the end of a terminal selection to a cell, growing the selection.
Tree::extend_text_field_selection: Moves the end of a text field selection to an offset, keeping the anchor.
Tree::focused: Returns the node that currently has keyboard focus, if any.
Tree::get: Returns a node by id, or None if it no longer exists.
Tree::get_mut: Returns a mutable node by id and marks the tree as needing a frame.
Tree::has_shaders: Returns whether any node has a shader.
Tree::hide_layer: Closes a layer, keeping it alive, and returns the settings it was opened with.
Tree::hit_test: Returns the topmost node at a point, testing in reverse paint order.
Tree::hit_test_input: Returns the node that input at a point reaches, with open modal layers blocking others.
Tree::hit_test_local: Returns the node at a point together with the point in that node's own space.
Tree::image_nodes: Iterates every image node in the tree with its image state.
Tree::insert: Creates a new parentless node and returns its id.
Tree::insert_child: Attaches a child under a parent at a given position in its child list.
Tree::is_layer: Returns whether a node is an open layer or overlay.
Tree::layout: Returns a node's computed layout box from the last layout pass.
Tree::local_to_window: Converts a point in a node's own space into window space.
Tree::mark_dirty: Marks the tree as needing a frame.
Tree::max_scroll: Returns how far a scroll view can scroll, or None if it is not a scroll view.
Tree::move_focus: Moves keyboard focus to the next or previous node in tab order, wrapping at the ends.
Tree::open_overlay: Opens content as an overlay positioned just below its anchor node.
Tree::overlay_meta: Returns the settings of an open overlay, if the node is one.
Tree::pointer_capture: Returns the node that currently captures pointer events, if any.
Tree::position_overlay_over: Positions an overlay's content so it covers a given rectangle.
Tree::remove: Removes a node and its whole subtree, detaching it from its parent.
Tree::root_of: Returns the top of a node's tree, or the node itself if it has no parent.
Tree::scroll_by_key: Scrolls a view for a key: arrows by a line, Page keys by a page, Home and End to the ends.
Tree::scroll_into_view: Scrolls the enclosing scroll views just enough to show a node.
Tree::scroll_scroll_view_by: Moves a scroll view's position by a pixel amount, clamped to its range.
Tree::scroll_view_for_key: Returns the scroll view that a key press scrolls, starting from a node.
Tree::scroll_virtual_list_by: Moves a virtual list's scroll offset by a pixel amount, clamped to its range.
Tree::select_all_text_field: Selects all the text in a text field.
Tree::set_access: Sets a node's accessibility role, label and actions.
Tree::set_canvas_content: Replaces a canvas node's draw commands and optional custom hit test.
Tree::set_focus_to: Moves keyboard focus directly to a node and returns the old and new focus.
Tree::set_hit_testable: Sets whether a node can claim a hit by itself.
Tree::set_hovered: Sets the hovered node and returns the previous one if it changed.
Tree::set_layout_style: Updates a node's layout style and keeps the layout engine in sync.
Tree::set_pointer_capture: Routes all later pointer events to a node until capture is cleared.
Tree::set_terminal_selection_start: Starts a terminal selection at a cell, collapsing any existing selection.
Tree::set_text_field_cursor: Moves a text field's cursor to a character offset and clears its selection.
Tree::set_virtual_list_resolved_offsets: Supplies the measured cumulative offsets for a variable-height virtual list.
Tree::set_virtual_list_window: Creates and recycles a virtual list's row nodes to match the visible index range.
Tree::shader_cycle: Returns whether giving a node a shader would make a shader depend on itself.
Tree::show_layer: Shows a node as a layer on top of every open layer, anchored by its settings.
Tree::take_dirty: Returns whether the tree needs a frame and clears the flag.
Tree::take_dismissals: Returns the layers an outside press or Escape asked to dismiss since the last call.
Tree::take_scroll_changes: Returns each scroll view whose offset changed since the last call, as (view, old, new).
Tree::terminal_selected_text: Returns the text selected in a terminal, if any.
Tree::text_field_selected_text: Returns the text selected in a text field, if any.
Tree::tick_all: Advances every animation to the given time and returns finished ones.
Tree::try_add_child: Attaches a child under a parent unless that would create a cycle.
Tree::update_hover: Updates the hovered node from a pointer position and returns the old one if it changed.
Tree::virtual_list_adopt: Attaches a caller-built node as a given row of a virtual list.
Tree::virtual_list_release_outside: Detaches the list's rows outside a range and returns them, still alive.
Tree::virtual_list_visible: Returns the range of rows a virtual list's viewport currently shows.
Tree::window_to_local: Converts a window-space point into a node's own space.
AccessValue: An accessible value: text for text controls or a number for range controls.
AccessValue::Number: A numeric value, such as a slider position.
CellColor: A terminal cell color: the default, a palette index or a direct RGB value.
CellColor::Default: The terminal's default foreground or background color.
CellColor::Indexed: A color chosen by palette index.
ChangedValue: The value a node held before an input changed it.
ChangedValue::Text: The previous text of a text field.
ContentFit: How an image is fitted into its node's box.
ContentFit::Cover: Scales the image to cover the box, cropping the overflow, centered.
ContentFit::Contain: Scales the image to fit inside the box, leaving bars where there is slack, centered.
ContentFit::Fill: Stretches the image to the box exactly, ignoring its aspect ratio.
Cursor: The mouse pointer shape a node asks for, named as in CSS.
Cursor::Pointer: A pointing hand, for clickable items.
Cursor::Grab: An open hand, for something that can be dragged.
Cursor::Grabbing: A closed hand, for something being dragged.
Cursor::Move: A four-way arrow, for something that can be moved.
Cursor::NotAllowed: A prohibited sign, for an action that is not allowed.
Cursor::Wait: A busy indicator while the app cannot respond.
Cursor::Progress: A busy indicator while the app is still usable.
Cursor::NeswResize: A diagonal resize arrow from top right to bottom left.
Cursor::NwseResize: A diagonal resize arrow from top left to bottom right.
Cursor::Copy: A pointer showing that dropping will copy.
Cursor::Cell: A plus-shaped pointer for selecting cells.
Cursor::ContextMenu: A pointer showing that a context menu is available.
Cursor::ZoomIn: A magnifier with a plus, for zooming in.
Cursor::ZoomOut: A magnifier with a minus, for zooming out.
Cursor::AllScroll: A four-way arrow showing the content scrolls in any direction.
Cursor::from_name: Looks up a cursor by its snake_case name.
Cursor::name: Returns the cursor's snake_case name.
CustomHitTest: A custom hit-test shape for a canvas node.
CustomHitTest::Circle: Hits when the point is within a radius of a center, in node-local units.
CustomHitTest::Path: Hits when the point is within a tolerance of a path, in node-local units.
DispatchOutcome: What the tree reports back to the host after handling one input event.
DispatchOutcome::None: Nothing needing the host's attention happened.
DispatchOutcome::Activated: A node was activated by a primary click or by Enter or Space while focused.
DispatchOutcome::SecondaryActivated: A node was activated by a secondary-button (right) click.
DispatchOutcome::HoverChanged: The hovered node changed, from the old node to the new one.
DispatchOutcome::Changed: A node's value was edited, such as a text field keystroke, with its previous value.
DispatchOutcome::FocusChanged: Keyboard focus moved from the old node to the new one.
DockSide: A zone of the fixed dock layout.
DockSide::Left: The zone along the left edge.
DockSide::Right: The zone along the right edge.
DockSide::Top: The zone along the top edge.
DockSide::Bottom: The zone along the bottom edge.
DrawCommand: One drawing instruction for a canvas node.
DrawCommand::FillRect: Fills a rectangle with a color.
DrawCommand::FillCircle: Fills a circle with a color.
DrawCommand::StrokePath: Strokes a path with a color and line width.
FocusDirection: The direction keyboard focus moves in tab order.
FocusDirection::Next: Moves to the next focusable node (Tab).
FocusDirection::Previous: Moves to the previous focusable node (Shift+Tab).
InputEvent: The platform-neutral input events the tree handles.
InputEvent::PointerMoved: The pointer moved to a position.
InputEvent::PointerPressed: A pointer button was pressed at a position.
InputEvent::PointerReleased: A pointer button was released at a position.
InputEvent::KeyPressed: A navigation key was pressed, with the Shift state.
InputEvent::KeyReleased: A navigation key was released, with the Shift state.
InputEvent::TextInput: A typed character or string was entered.
InputEvent::ControlChar: A Ctrl+letter shortcut other than copy, cut or paste was pressed.
InputEvent::TerminalCopyRequested: The terminal copy shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+C) was pressed.
InputEvent::ImePreedit: An input method composition preview changed.
InputEvent::Scroll: The wheel or trackpad scrolled by a delta at a pointer position.
InputEvent::ThemeChanged: The system switched between light and dark appearance.
InputEvent::Focused: The window gained or lost system focus.
InputEvent::Resized: The window's client area changed size.
InputEvent::Key: A named key was pressed or released, with a flag for auto-repeat.
InputEvent::ScaleFactorChanged: The window moved to a display with a different scale factor.
InputEvent::PointerLeft: The pointer left the window, which clears hover.
ItemExtent: The height of a virtual list's items: one fixed size or measured per item.
ItemExtent::Fixed: Every item has the same given height.
ItemExtent::Variable: Items differ in height, and the caller supplies the measured offsets.
Key: The keyboard keys the tree handles itself.
Key::PageUp: The Page Up key, which scrolls a view up by its viewport.
Key::PageDown: The Page Down key, which scrolls a view down by its viewport.
MotionCurve: An animation's easing curve: linear or a CSS-style cubic bezier.
MotionCurve::Bezier: A CSS-style cubic bezier easing given as (x1, y1, x2, y2).
NodeKind: What a node is, with any data specific to that kind.
NodeKind::Container: A layout container that holds children.
NodeKind::VirtualList: A long list that only creates nodes for the rows currently visible.
NodeKind::Canvas: Custom-drawn content with an optional custom hit test.
NodeKind::Image: A decoded image painted as a GPU texture.
NodeKind::Path: A vector path that can be filled, stroked, trimmed and morphed.
NodeKind::Terminal: A terminal screen showing a grid of character cells.
NodeKind::ScrollView: A scrollable viewport over one oversized child.
Placement: Which side of its anchor an overlay appears on.
Placement::Start: Before the anchor on the horizontal axis (left, in left-to-right text).
Placement::End: After the anchor on the horizontal axis.
Placement::opposite: Returns the placement on the opposite side of the anchor.
PointerButton: A pointer button: primary, secondary, middle, back or forward.
PointerButton::Primary: The main button, usually the left mouse button.
PointerButton::Secondary: The secondary button, usually the right mouse button.
PointerButton::Middle: The middle button, usually the wheel click.
ScrollDelta: How far a wheel or trackpad scrolled, in lines or in pixels.
ScrollDelta::Lines: A scroll amount counted in lines, as (x, y).
ScrollDelta::Pixels: A scroll amount counted in pixels, as (x, y).
ShaderMode: How a shader applies to its node.
ShaderMode::Fill: Paints the node's box behind its content as a procedural fill.
ShaderMode::Effect: Transforms the node's own rendered content.
ShaderMode::name: Returns the mode's name as used from Python.
TextAlign: Horizontal alignment of text within its box.
TextAlign::Start: Aligns to the left for left-to-right text and the right for right-to-left.
TextAlign::End: Aligns to the right for left-to-right text and the left for right-to-left.
UniformKind: The type of a shader uniform.
UniformValue: A shader uniform's value: one float or a vector of two to four floats.
UniformValue::kind: Returns the uniform type of this value.
WindowRegion: A node's role in moving the window when the app draws its own title bar.
WindowRegion::Default: Decided by the nodes around it.
WindowRegion::Drag: A press here, or on a non-interactive node inside, moves the window.
WindowRegion::NoDrag: A press here, or inside, never moves the window.
Interpolate: A value type that can be blended between two values, so it can be animated.
Interpolate::interpolate: Returns the blend between this value and another at progress t from 0 to 1.
ctrl_shortcut: Maps Ctrl plus a letter to the input event it means, if any.
fit_transform: Returns the transform that scales and centers a view box into a width and height.
frame_block: Returns the bytes of the per-frame shader uniform block for a size and time.
from_access_id: Converts an accessibility node id back into a tree node id.
node_id_as_u64: Returns a stable u64 for a node id.
to_access_id: Converts a tree node id into a stable accessibility node id.
trim: Returns the part of a path between two fractions of its length.
FRAME_BLOCK_SIZE: The size in bytes of the per-frame shader uniform block.
KEY_SCROLL_LINE: How far an arrow key scrolls a scroll view, in pixels.
SCROLLBAR_GRAB_SLOP: How far either side of a scrollbar thumb still counts as grabbing it.
SCROLLBAR_MARGIN: The gap between a scrollbar track and the edge of its view.
SCROLLBAR_MIN_LENGTH: The shortest a scrollbar thumb is drawn.
